description: This file implements a headless Android Fragment that manages a background network fetch task using AsyncTask. It handles network connectivity checks, performs HTTPS GET requests asynchronously, and communicates progress and results back to the host activity via a callback interface.

classes.name: NetworkFragment
classes.description: A headless Fragment that manages network download tasks, retaining instance across configuration changes, and communicates with its host context

classes.name: NetworkFragment.DownloadTask
classes.description: An AsyncTask subclass that handles network operations in background, performing HTTP GET requests and processing responses.

classes.name: NetworkFragment.DownloadTask.Result
classes.description: A wrapper class holding either a string result or an exception, used to communicate outcome of the background task.

methods.name: NetworkFragment.getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing instance of NetworkFragment attached to a FragmentManager, setting the URL for download.

methods.name: NetworkFragment.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, restoring arguments and setting retention across config changes.

methods.name: NetworkFragment.onAttach
methods.description: Assigns the callback interface when fragment attaches to context.

methods.name: NetworkFragment.onDetach
methods.description: Removes the callback reference when fragment detaches.

methods.name: NetworkFragment.onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by cancelling any ongoing download when the fragment is destroyed.

methods.name: DownloadTask.doInBackground
methods.description: Performs network request on background thread, fetching data from the specified URL.

methods.name: DownloadTask.downloadUrl
methods.description: Handles establishing HTTPS connection, requesting, and reading response body from URL.

methods.name: DownloadTask.readStream
methods.description: Reads data from InputStream and converts to String, with a maximum length.
